missingCriteria.zh-CN: 规则「{name}」缺少「## 判据」段落，TypeSafe 无法判断它。请补上 true: 和 false: 两行定义。
missingCriteria.en-US: Rule "{name}" has no "## Criteria" section, so TypeSafe cannot judge it. Add true: and false: definitions.

duplicateJudgmentId.zh-CN: 多条规则的判断标识都是 {id}，{file} 已改用 {resolved}。建议在规则 front matter 里给每条规则一个唯一的 name。
duplicateJudgmentId.en-US: Several rules share the judgment id {id}; {file} uses {resolved} instead. Give each rule a unique name in its front matter.

judgmentInstructions.zh-CN: `diff` 中新增或修改的代码是否违反规则「{rule}」？只判断新增和修改的行，不要判断未改动的代码。
judgmentInstructions.en-US: Does code added or changed in `diff` violate the rule "{rule}"? Judge only added and modified lines, never untouched code.

fallbackCriterionFalse.zh-CN: 新增或修改的代码没有违反该规则，或者这次改动根本没有涉及该规则约束的写法。
fallbackCriterionFalse.en-US: No added or modified line violates that rule, or the change does not touch anything the rule governs.

localizeInstructions.zh-CN: `candidate_lines` 里哪一行新增或修改的代码最直接地违反规则「{rule}」？规则含义：{criterion}。如果违规点不落在任何一个候选行上，选 {none}。
localizeInstructions.en-US: Which line in `candidate_lines` most directly violates the rule "{rule}"? Rule meaning: {criterion}. Choose {none} when the violation does not fall on any candidate line.

candidateNone.zh-CN: 以上候选行都不是，或者违规点不落在某一行上
candidateNone.en-US: None of the candidate lines; the violation is not attributable to one line
